Cutaway of the chiller: warm water enters, heat is drawn out into its refrigerant circuit, cold water leaves back toward the hall.
The heat path climbs from the chiller to a unit on the roof; heat lifts off it into the open sky.
The whole building section with the chain of links lit one after another as each is named, heat passing along it.

The two questions sit beside the finished building drawing, the chain still running behind them.

why: In b06 arrive (28.72s), b12 arrive (71.45s), b14 arrive (90.35s), and b17 arrive (108.73s), the heat chain cards at the bottom display clipped, partially-lettered words ('serve'', 'aii', 'wate'', 'outdoor'') because heat_chain in _kit.js does not apply drafted state to the text elements when drafted: true is passed.

data.fix: In scenes/_kit.js within Loom.lesson.heat_chain, set the text paths to fully drawn at ctx.start when opts.drafted !== false so that chain labels appear complete upon scene arrival.

why: In b25 arrive (177.75s), the operator icon, alarm connector line, and 'water covers the gap' note from b24 linger as floating residue across the sky and plant room after the alarm monitor has vanished.

data.fix: In scenes/b24.js, trigger m.exit on operator, alarmLabel, and gapNote at ctx.speechEnd - ctx.style.dur('exit') so they clear completely before b25 arrives.

why: In b04 settled (21.34s), the 'outdoors' link card retains a persistent cyan highlight outline after the narration finishes 'Let's follow it out, link by link', falsely highlighting the fourth link as active before the walkthrough starts.

data.fix: In scenes/b04.js, change the highlight call on card index 3 so end equals at + step rather than ctx.end, returning the card to its neutral outlined state.

why: In b19 arrive (126.30s), the recall flows from b18 continue receding until 128.82s while b19's failure overlay and dimmed air flows arrive at 125.83s, causing a double exposure across the chapter cut.

data.fix: In scenes/b18.js, set recall_flow_sheet exit to conclude by ctx.speechEnd so old flows leave before b19 arrives.

why: In b21 arrive (143.45s), the monitor panel in the upper left displays incomplete border strokes and clipped row labels (': c'', '· c'') mid-lettering.

data.fix: In scenes/b21.js, delay revealing monitor_panel until tAlarm using ctx.m.reveal so it does not show incomplete text fragments on beat arrival.

why: In b06 arrive (28.72s), the heat chain cards along the bottom show clipped, partially-lettered text ('serve'', 'aii', 'wate'', 'outdoor'') because heat_chain does not apply drafted state to label text elements when drafted: true is passed.

data.fix: In scenes/_kit.js, update Loom.lesson.heat_chain so that when opts.drafted is not false, lab.inner.querySelectorAll('path') also sets strokeDasharray to 'none', strokeDashoffset to 0, and opacity to 1 at ctx.start.

why: In b19 arrive (126.30s), heat flow marks from b18 linger on the roof cooler until 128.77s while b19 arrives at 125.83s, creating a double exposure across the chapter cut.

data.fix: In scenes/b18.js, end or exit the roof heat marks and flow elements by 125.83s so they clear before b19 arrives.
